# LayoutSize

How one axis of a [Layout](Layout.md) child is sized.

## Values

- `"fit"`: To its content: a label to its measured text, an element to its own size, a layout to its children.
- `{"fixed": <number>}`: This many pixels.
- `{"fill": <number>}`: A share of the space its siblings leave, by this weight.
